agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario fails pole_upright at step 17 (theta -0.81 rad, limit 0.8) with no external pushes. Sensor noise 0.008 causes controller to mis-estimate angle (initial theta 0.1 at limit) leading to incorrect/inadequate corrective force; cart accelerates to ~3.9 m/s while pole diverges with omega ~-5.7 rad/s. Removing noise alone restores stability, proving noise-induced feedback destabilization is the cause.
